iku.name: Iku surface-mounted downlight IP65, IK07
iku.caveat: ERCO lists the Iku at 3000 K; the datasheet says 2700 K / CRI 92 is available on request. No 2700 K file exists, so the 3000 K photometry is used; the optic is the same, flux of the 2700 K variant is unknown and typically a few % lower (V12 headroom covers it).

kew25.name: Kew 25 Spike Olive Green Medium 2027, 500 mA, IP66 spike spotlight
kew25.dimming: DALI (driver option; DALI-2 not stated in the datasheet)
kew25.status: V10: peak 479 cd and beam 22 deg pass; lumens FAIL at the 2 % bar (file integrates 90.9 lm vs 93 stated, -2.25 %); the file is the Kew 25 family file (LUMCAT GLK2XMXX3, 2023), not the 2027 article's own
kew25.caveat: IP66 spike, not in-ground IP67: no in-ground product with 2700 K + CRI >= 90 + a downloadable file was found. DALI-2 and the exact-article LDT are to be confirmed with John Cullen.
